rows: Confer with company officials about financial and regulatory matters.

Within this audit-heavy source cluster, conferring with officials supplies and communicates financial or regulatory context for the engagement, but the wording can also describe general advisory work.
Examine and evaluate financial and information systems, recommending controls to ensure system reliability and data integrity.
Evaluating systems and recommending reliability and data-integrity controls is an information-systems or controls-assurance variant, not ownership of system implementation.
Review accounts for discrepancies and reconcile differences.
Reconciliation resolves discrepancies so account balances can be maintained accurately; the audit-related DWA makes assurance use plausible as well.
Report to management regarding the finances of establishment.
Reporting establishment finances to management makes financial information usable for internal decisions; generic financial-statement issuance would instead fall under ACC-01.
Examine whether the organization's objectives are reflected in its management activities, and whether employees understand the objectives.

Testing whether management activity and employee understanding align with organizational objectives is an operational or performance-audit variant, although its DWA also resembles organizational consulting.
Audit payroll and personnel records to determine unemployment insurance premiums, workers' compensation coverage, liabilities, and compliance with tax laws.
The explicit audit of payroll and personnel records produces an assurance and compliance determination; tax and insurance subject matter do not change that responsibility.
Review taxpayer accounts, and conduct audits on-site, by correspondence, or by summoning taxpayer to office.

Authority-side examination of taxpayer accounts is assigned to audit and assurance because the stated occupational outcome is an audit finding; tax subject matter remains a structured secondary link to ACC-04.
Advise clients in areas such as compensation, employee health care benefits, the design of accounting or data processing systems, or long-range tax or estate plans.

The statement's common outcome is client advice for long-range organizational or financial choices, but it combines compensation, benefits, systems, tax, and estate domains that cannot be split under one-to-one mapping.

Reviewing assets, liabilities, equity, income, and expenditure data supports accurate period-end records and statements, but the same data can also support management analysis.
Develop treatment plans for radiology patients.

Developing treatment plans is distinct from routine image-based diagnosis and most naturally supports interventional or procedural radiologic care, but the generic wording can also include therapeutic nuclear medicine.
Document the performance, interpretation, or outcomes of all procedures performed.
Documenting the performance and outcome of procedures is integral to procedural care, but 'all procedures performed' can encompass non-interventional and nuclear medicine procedures as well.

Assemble and fasten materials to make frameworks or props, using hand tools and wood screws, nails, dowel pins, or glue.
Frameworks can be permanent, but the explicit inclusion of props and the matching O*NET DWA for temporary structures make site-support work the best dominant fit.
Install rough door and window frames, subflooring, fixtures, or temporary supports in structures undergoing construction or repair.
Most listed outputs are permanent rough components; temporary supports create a secondary overlap with the site-support bundle.
Perform minor plumbing, welding, or concrete mixing work.
Minor concrete mixing can directly support forms and posts, while plumbing and welding are adjacent-trade interfaces; no separate bundle is justified by one heterogeneous supplemental statement.
Dig or direct digging of post holes and set poles to support structures.
Setting poles can create a permanent structure, but excavation, support positioning, and direction of site labor align most closely with site-support and foundation-interface work.
Use drones for site surveying and to inspect hard-to-reach areas of a structure.

Drone-based surveying primarily produces site and structure information used to plan and coordinate field work. The same statement also covers inspection of existing structures, creating a real boundary overlap with CAN-47-2031-02; it remains in planning because the wording is not limited to defect-led restoration.

Revision can serve both reported-news and commentary outputs; the home follows the statement's position within the reported-news production cluster.
Review written, audio, or video copy, and correct errors in content, grammar, or punctuation, following prescribed editorial style and formatting guidelines.
Copy editing is shared by reported news and commentary; it is assigned to the broad reported-news responsibility for accounting.

Record patients' medical history, vital statistics, or information such as test results in medical records.
Recording medical history, vital statistics, and test results is part of clinical intake but also maintains the administrative record of the encounter.
Appointment scheduling is a front-office output that directly enables a later clinical encounter.
Contact medical facilities or departments to schedule patients for tests or admission.
Scheduling external tests or admission is administratively performed but coordinates clinical follow-through.
Participate in fire drills and demonstrations of fire fighting techniques.
Fire drills primarily maintain response readiness but may also demonstrate prevention practices to others.
Operate vehicles or powered equipment, such as mowers, tractors, twin-axle vehicles, snow blowers, chainsaws, electric clippers, sod cutters, or pruning saws.
Powered equipment supports both recurring grounds maintenance and landscape installation; maintenance remains the accounting home.
Use hand tools, such as shovels, rakes, pruning saws, saws, hedge or brush trimmers, or axes.
Generic hand-tool use supports both recurring grounds maintenance and landscape installation; maintenance remains the accounting home.

Planning or cultivating lawns and gardens most directly supports establishment, while cultivation can also describe recurring maintenance.
Inspect equipment for safety prior to use, and perform necessary basic maintenance tasks.
Safety inspection and basic maintenance support both harvesting/processing and skidding/loading equipment; it is homed in the first variant for accounting only.
Fill out required job or shift report forms.
Job or shift reports can document either logging-equipment assignment; the home mapping follows the material-movement cluster for accounting only.
